subject: Mathematics
title: Differentiation
summary: The derivative f′(x) = lim (h→0) (f(x + h) − f(x))/h measures the instantaneous rate of change and the slope of the tangent.

Learn the standard derivatives and the rules: sum, product, quotient and chain rule. Special techniques: implicit, logarithmic, parametric differentiation, and derivatives of inverse trigonometric functions using substitution.
Higher-order derivatives and the derivative of one function with respect to another complete the chapter.

formulas.name: Power, exponential, log
formulas.formula: d(xⁿ)/dx = nxⁿ⁻¹;  d(eˣ)/dx = eˣ;  d(aˣ)/dx = aˣ ln a;  d(ln x)/dx = 1/x;  d(logₐx)/dx = 1/(x ln a)

formulas.name: Trigonometric
formulas.formula: (sin x)′ = cos x;  (cos x)′ = −sin x;  (tan x)′ = sec²x;  (cot x)′ = −cosec²x;  (sec x)′ = sec x tan x;  (cosec x)′ = −cosec x cot x

formulas.name: Chain rule
formulas.note: Differentiate outer, keep inner, then multiply by the inner derivative.

formulas.name: Implicit differentiation
formulas.formula: differentiate both sides w.r.t. x, treating y as a function of x;  then solve for dy/dx

formulas.name: Logarithmic differentiation
formulas.formula: y = u^v ⇒ ln y = v ln u ⇒ y′/y = v′ ln u + v u′/u

formulas.name: Derivative of one function w.r.t. another
Substitution for inverse trig
formulas.formula: √(1 − x²) → x = sin θ;  (1 − x²)/(1 + x²) → x = tan θ;  2x/(1 − x²) → x = tan θ

examples.title: Logarithmic differentiation
examples.solution: ln y = x ln x ⇒ y′/y = ln x + 1 ⇒ y′ = xˣ(1 + ln x).

examples.title: Parametric
examples.problem: x = t², y = 2t. Find dy/dx at t = 2.

examples.title: Second derivative
examples.problem: y = x³. Find y″ at x = 2.

examples.title: Inverse-trig substitution
examples.problem: d/dx tan⁻¹(2x/(1 − x²)) for |x| < 1, at x = 0?
examples.solution: With x = tan θ the function is 2θ = 2tan⁻¹x, so the derivative is 2/(1 + x²) = 2 at x = 0.

topics.title: Derivative as rate
topics.explain: If s(t) is position, s′(t) is velocity and s″(t) acceleration. dy/dx at a point is the slope of the tangent there.

topics.title: Derivatives of modulus and greatest integer
topics.explain: d|x|/dx = x/|x| (x ≠ 0). [x] has derivative 0 between integers and is not differentiable at integers.

topics.title: Derivative of determinants
topics.explain: Differentiate one row at a time and add the resulting determinants.

topics.title: Rolle's and mean value theorems
topics.explain: Rolle's: f continuous on [a, b], differentiable on (a, b), f(a) = f(b) ⇒ f′(c) = 0 for some c. LMVT: f′(c) = (f(b) − f(a))/(b − a).

topics.title: Even/odd and derivatives
topics.explain: The derivative of an even function is odd and that of an odd function is even. Derivatives of periodic functions are periodic with the same period.

topics.title: Leibniz rule for nth derivatives
topics.explain: (uv)⁽ⁿ⁾ = Σ C(n, r) u⁽ⁿ⁻ʳ⁾ v⁽ʳ⁾. Useful for xⁿeˣ-type products.

ratta: (tan x)′ = sec²x;  (sec x)′ = sec x tan x.
